title: Leonora

{{NPC Infobox |image = .png |type = Open-World |nation = Rinascita |location = Septimont }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Quest-Exclusive NPC seen during {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}} at Tempest Cliff.
She is found saying farewell with a male Gladiator, '''Mars''', heading to the Hunt. {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== ;(Talk to Leonora) :'''Mars:''' Don't worry about me, Leonora. [[Augusta]] commands this hunt, and [[Avidius]] rides with us. Victory is assured. :'''Leonora:''' Still, this is your first time joining a hunt like this… :'''Mars:''' No Gladiator would deny themselves such an honor. We've trained all these years for this moment, haven't we? :'''Leonora:''' I wish I'd been chosen to go with you… :'''Mars:''' It'll be fine, Leonora. Bless me with your heart, and you'll be with me wherever I go. :'''Leonora:''' I'll wait for you right here till you return. :'''Leonora:''' Mars… ---- ;(Talk to Leonora again) :'''Leonora:''' Forget the honor, just come back to me safe. :{{DIcon}} Trust him. :'''Leonora:''' This is all I can do now. :'''Leonora:''' You'll be out there with them, right? :'''Leonora:''' I'll be hoping for your safe return too. {{Dialogue End}} ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Leonora |zhs = 蕾欧诺拉 |zht = 蕾歐諾拉 |ja = レオノーラ |ko = 레오노라 |fr = Leonora |de = Leonora |es = Leonora |th = Leonora }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.6}}
